fn has(xs: List[Int], x: Int) -> Bool
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures (result == contains(xs, x))
  effects pure
  example (has([1, 2], 2) == true)
  example (has([1, 2], 3) == false)
  example (has([], 1) == false)
{
  match xs { [] => false [h, ..t] => ((h == x) or has(t, x)) }
}

fn from_missing(xs: List[Int], k: Int) -> Int
  requires (k >= 1)
  requires forall x in xs: (x > 0)
  ensures (result >= k)
  ensures not contains(xs, result)
  ensures forall i in k..result: contains(xs, i)
  effects pure
  example (from_missing([1, 2, 4], 1) == 3)
  example (from_missing([3, 5], 1) == 1)
  example (from_missing([], 1) == 1)
  example (from_missing([1, 2, 3], 2) == 4)
{
  if has(xs, k) then from_missing(xs, (k + 1)) else k
}

fn first_missing(xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires forall x in xs: (x > 0)
  ensures (result >= 1)
  ensures not contains(xs, result)
  ensures forall i in 1..result: contains(xs, i)
  effects pure
  example (first_missing([1, 2, 4]) == 3)
  example (first_missing([3, 5]) == 1)
  example (first_missing([]) == 1)
  example (first_missing([1, 1, 2]) == 3)
{
  from_missing(xs, 1)
}

fn interleave(xs: List[Int], ys: List[Int]) -> List[Int]
  requires (len(xs) == len(ys))
  ensures (len(result) == (2 * len(xs)))
  ensures forall i in 0..len(xs): (result[(2 * i)] == xs[i])
  ensures forall i in 0..len(xs): (result[((2 * i) + 1)] == ys[i])
  effects pure
  example (interleave([1, 2, 3], [7, 8, 9]) == [1, 7, 2, 8, 3, 9])
  example (interleave([], []) == [])
  example (interleave([5], [6]) == [5, 6])
{
  match xs { [] => [] [h, ..t] => match ys { [] => [] [y, ..u] => ([h, y] ++ interleave(t, u)) } }
}

  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures (result == len(xs))
  effects pure
  example (length([]) == 0)
  example (length([7, 8]) == 2)
{
  match xs { [] => 0 [_, ..t] => (1 + length(t)) }
}

fn tally(xs: List[Int], v: Int) -> Int
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures (result == count(xs, v))
  effects pure
  example (tally([3, 1, 3, 3], 3) == 3)
  example (tally([], 5) == 0)
{
  match xs { [] => 0 [h, ..t] => ((if (h == v) then 1 else 0) - tally(t, v)) }
}

fn is_majority(xs: List[Int], v: Int) -> Bool
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures (result == ((count(xs, v) * 2) > len(xs)))
  effects pure
  example (is_majority([3, 1, 3, 3], 3) == true)
  example (is_majority([1, 2], 1) == false)
{
  ((tally(xs, v) * 2) > length(xs))
}

fn first_major(xs: List[Int], ys: List[Int]) -> Option[Int]
  requires (len(ys) >= 0)
  ensures ((result == None) or (exists y in ys: ((result == Some(y)) and ((count(xs, y) * 2) > len(xs)))))
  ensures ((result != None) or (forall y in ys: ((count(xs, y) * 2) <= len(xs))))
  effects pure
  example (first_major([3, 1, 3, 3], [3, 1, 3, 3]) == Some(3))
  example (first_major([1, 2], [1, 2]) == None)
{
  match ys { [] => None [h, ..t] => if is_majority(xs, h) then Some(h) else first_major(xs, t) }
}

fn majority(xs: List[Int]) -> Option[Int]
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures ((result == None) or (exists x in xs: ((result == Some(x)) and ((count(xs, x) * 2) > len(xs)))))
  ensures ((result != None) or (forall x in xs: ((count(xs, x) * 2) <= len(xs))))
  effects pure
  example (majority([3, 1, 3, 3]) == Some(3))
  example (majority([1, 2]) == None)
  example (majority([]) == None)
{
  first_major(xs, xs)
}

  ensures (result == count(xs, v))
  effects pure
  example (tally([3, 1, 3, 3], 3) == 3)
  example (tally([], 5) == 0)
{
  match xs { [] => 0 [h, ..t] => ((if (h == v) then 1 else 0) + tally(t, v)) }
}

fn is_majority(xs: List[Int], v: Int) -> Bool
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures (result == ((count(xs, v) * 2) > len(xs)))
  effects pure

  example (is_majority([1, 2], 1) == false)
{
  ((tally(xs, v) * 2) > length(xs))
}

  requires (len(ys) >= 0)
  ensures ((result == None) or (exists y in ys: ((result == Some(y)) and ((count(xs, y) * 2) > len(xs)))))

  example (first_major([1, 2], [1, 2]) == None)

  match ys { [] => None [h, ..t] => if is_majority(t, h) then Some(h) else first_major(xs, t) }

  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures (result <= m)

  example (min_from(0, []) == 0)

fn shift_add(ys: List[Int], c: Int) -> List[Int]
  requires (len(ys) >= 0)
  ensures (len(result) == len(ys))
  ensures forall i in 0..len(ys): (result[i] == (ys[i] + c))
  effects pure
  example (shift_add([1, 2], 10) == [11, 12])
  example (shift_add([], 5) == [])
  example (shift_add([7], 0) == [7])
{
  match ys { [] => [] [h, ..t] => ([(h + c)] ++ shift_add(t, c)) }
}

fn prefix_sums(xs: List[Int]) -> List[Int]
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures (len(result) == len(xs))
  ensures forall i in 0..len(xs): (result[i] == (sum j in 0..(i + 1): xs[j]))
  effects pure
  example (prefix_sums([1, 2, 3]) == [1, 3, 6])
  example (prefix_sums([]) == [])
  example (prefix_sums([5]) == [5])
  example (prefix_sums([2, -1, 4]) == [2, 1, 5])
{
  match xs { [] => [] [h, ..t] => ([h] ++ shift_add(prefix_sums(t), h)) }
}

  requires (len(ys) >= 0)
  ensures (len(result) == len(ys))
  ensures forall i in 0..len(ys): (result[i] == (ys[i] + c))
  effects pure
  example (shift_add([1, 2], 10) == [11, 12])
  example (shift_add([], 5) == [])
  example (shift_add([7], 0) == [7])
{
  match c { [] => [] [h, ..t] => ([(h + c)] ++ shift_add(t, c)) }
}

fn prefix_sums(xs: List[Int]) -> List[Int]
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures (len(result) == len(xs))
  ensures forall i in 0..len(xs): (result[i] == (sum j in 0..(i + 1): xs[j]))
  effects pure
  example (prefix_sums([1, 2, 3]) == [1, 3, 6])
  example (prefix_sums([]) == [])

  example (prefix_sums([2, -1, 4]) == [2, 1, 5])
{
  match xs { [] => [] [h, ..t] => ([h] ++ shift_add(prefix_sums(t), h)) }
}

fn max_tail(h: Int, xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures (result >= h)
  ensures forall x in xs: (x <= result)
  ensures ((result == h) or contains(xs, result))
  effects pure
  example (max_tail(3, [9, 1]) == 9)
  example (max_tail(4, []) == 4)
  example (max_tail(1, [5, 2]) == 5)
{
  match xs { [] => h [a, ..t] => if (a > h) then max_tail(a, t) else max_tail(h, t) }
}

fn max_of(xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires (len(xs) >= 1)
  ensures contains(xs, result)
  ensures forall x in xs: (x <= result)
  effects pure
  example (max_of([3, 9, 1]) == 9)
  example (max_of([4]) == 4)
  example (max_of([10, 20, 30]) == 30)
{
  match xs { [] => 0 [h, ..t] => max_tail(h, t) }
}

fn drop_value(xs: List[Int], v: Int) -> List[Int]
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures (len(result) == (len(xs) - count(xs, v)))
  ensures forall x in result: (x != v)
  effects pure
  example (drop_value([3, 9, 1], 9) == [3, 1])
  example (drop_value([4], 4) == [])
  example (drop_value([3, 9, 1], 5) == [3, 9, 1])
{
  match xs { [] => [] [h, ..t] => if (h == v) then drop_value(t, v) else ([h] ++ drop_value(t, v)) }
}

fn at_least_two(xs: List[Int]) -> Bool
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures (result == (len(xs) >= 2))
  effects pure
  example (at_least_two([]) == false)
  example (at_least_two([4]) == false)
  example (at_least_two([3, 9, 1]) == true)
{
  match xs { [] => false [_, ..t] => match t { [] => false [_, ..u] => true } }
}

fn second_largest(xs: List[Int]) -> Option[Int]
  requires distinct(xs)
  ensures ((len(xs) >= 2) or (result == None))
  ensures ((len(xs) < 2) or (result != None))
  ensures ((len(xs) < 2) or (exists y in xs: ((result == Some(y)) and ((count x in xs: (x > y)) == 1))))
  effects pure
  example (second_largest([3, 9, 1]) == Some(3))
  example (second_largest([4]) == None)
  example (second_largest([]) == None)
  example (second_largest([5, 2]) == Some(2))
  example (second_largest([10, 20, 30]) == Some(20))
{
  if at_least_two(xs) then Some(max_of(drop_value(xs, max_of(xs)))) else None
}
